title: Show the checked complex saving is half the consumed saving
body:
## Summary
- The assembly consumes `a_complex = 717/10000000`, which is exactly twice the checked saving `717/20000000`.
- The mutant adds five children to the last row, from `[756, 516232080]` to `[756, 516232085]`, with `m = 784` and `W = 537696432`.
- A 24-term logarithm lower bound, rounded down on the `10^30` grid, and a degree-4 exponential polynomial put the consumed-saving moment above `1 + 4/10^10`. Partial result. No new kappa and no selected-frontier change.

## Test plan
